summary: Iteration 6 fix-verification + full regression on SocialGrowth. PRIMARY FIX CONFIRMED: the tablet navbar overflow (768-930px) reported in iteration 5 is fully resolved - at 768x1024, 820x1180, 900x900 and 390x844 the brand-logo, lang-switcher and mobile-menu-toggle all sit fully inside the viewport (bounding-rect asserted against innerWidth, not scrollWidth), nav-cta is not visible, the hamburger is clickable and the mobile menu exposes all 4 mobile-nav-* links plus the new mobile-nav-cta, each of which scrolls correctly (contact lands at top ~0px). At 1024x900 and 1440x900 all 4 desktop nav links + lang-switcher + nav-cta are inside the viewport and clickable and the hamburger is not rendered. Logo polish confirmed: yakuza.png (200, mean RGB 11,95,55 - bright green tile, readable YAKUZA wordmark) and twisteast.png (200, mean RGB 48,70,84 - dark navy, large white TWIST EAST wordmark filling the tile), both legible in a 2.4x zoomed card screenshot. Regressions all green: 25 distinct clients / 50 cards across 3 marquee rows (row 2 animation-direction:reverse), 50/50 logo imgs decoded with zero broken srcs, 16 distinct client-link-<id> overlay anchors (9 site-less clients correctly have none), 37 distinct social anchors, document.querySelectorAll('a a').length === 0 at 390/768/1024/1920, clicking client-link-crats opened https://crats.gr/ and client-crats-ig opened instagram.com/crats.gr, hover pauses ONLY the hovered row (['running','paused','running']) and resumes on unhover, stat card 02 counter animates to 25+, EL/EN switcher swaps all copy including English client name variants, and zero horizontal overflow for hero/clients/results/services/process/contact at all 4 widths. ZERO console errors or warnings across every viewport after scrolling the full page. Backend 10/10 pytest pass and contact form E2E through the UI returned 200 with the Greek success confirmation and a cleared form.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking issues. Navbar.js lg: breakpoint split (desktop nav/nav-cta lg:flex, hamburger lg:hidden) is the correct fix and leaves no dead zone between 768px and 1024px.

Minor testability nit (no fix needed): data-testid='contact-status' is only present before submit - after a successful post the confirmation text renders inside the submit button and the contact-status node is removed, so future scripts should assert the button text rather than waiting on contact-status.
seed_data_creation: Two contact rows via API tests (TEST_ prefixed) plus one UI submission qa.iter6.<ts>@example.com; contact collection is append-only with no PII listing endpoint.
test_credentials: None required - no auth in app
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 found ZERO defects; the iteration-5 tablet navbar overflow is fixed. Testing gotchas learned this run: (1) body has overflow-x:hidden so assert element getBoundingClientRect().right <= innerWidth instead of documentElement.scrollWidth; (2) hero and process sections have NO id attribute - select them via [data-testid='hero'] / [data-testid='process'], getElementById returns null; (3) stat cards are data-testid='stat-card-0..3' (card '02' == stat-card-1), there is no stat-card-02; (4) marquee rows are unstable for Playwright .hover() - hover the parent .marquee-wrap (viewport width) instead, since the pause rule is .marquee-wrap:hover .marquee; (5) do NOT use a .test TLD email for the contact form - pydantic email-validator rejects reserved TLDs with 422 (this is correct behaviour, not a bug). Accepted/known items: formsubmit.co needs a one-time mailbox activation click, and the contact form shows only a transient sonner toast on failure.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found. Prior iteration-5 defect root cause was desktop nav/CTA using md: (768px) while the hamburger hid at md:, creating a 768-1024px window where logo + nav + switcher + CTA exceeded available width; moving both to the lg: breakpoint and adding mobile-nav-cta removed the dead zone.
